title: Slow Cooker Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Chicken thighs slow-cooked in a creamy, spiced tomato sauce until fall-apart tender.
steps: Add the chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, spices and tomatoes to the slow cooker.
Cook on low for 4-5 hours until the chicken is tender.
Stir through the yogurt just before serving, and finish with coriander.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food slow cooker collection

notes: Add the yogurt only at the end — stirring it in earlier can cause it to split under prolonged heat.
